description:
Configure the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server to execute Python scripts (.py) as CGI applications. Currently, visiting a Python script URL displays the source code or downloads the file instead of running it. 

Goal: Modify the web server configuration for 'acmecorp.test' so that files with the `.py` extension are treated as CGI scripts and executed. 

There is a test script located at http://acmecorp.test/agent_test.py. You can use this to verify your configuration works (it should display a success token, not the source code).
